Heinrich Dohmann and Carsten Bulmahn describe customised extrusion dies; CFD compares flow distribution, pressure and rheological effects.
Matthias Richwin's team models capacitive touch-pad geometry with finger/glove conditions and integrated automotive roof modules.
Christian Nerbl and Ronny Leonhardt describe coffee-machine thermal and control development using CFD and fast system simulation.
V. Narayan and collaborators design reaction-site heat pathways for uniformity, isolation and robustness to flowing reagent.
MED Institute models device-dependent RF heating in MRI exposure configurations, combining electromagnetics and thermal analysis.
Travis Schauer and Ismail Guler describe drug-coating release models with effective pore/shell transport representations.
Guillaume Malet, design engineer, describes microtube recuperator development using fluid, thermal and structural analyses.
Friedrich Maier, senior CAE simulation scientist, describes bioreactor heat-jacket, sensor and thermal-control design.
Robb Bass describes simulation of tube/bellows forming with tool kinematics, stock, pressure, thinning and springback.
Antoni Vilatimó, laboratory engineer, describes LED PCB thermal optimisation inside a constrained enclosure.
Shane Mooney describes packaging geometry automation and an existing trained physics surrogate; vendor AI belongs in the incumbent panel.
